Rice_Blast.name: Rice Blast (Konkan)
Rice_Blast.treatment: Apply balanced N-P-K. Maintain shallow water. Avoid excessive nitrogen. Use resistant varieties like IR36, Jaya, or KR-62.
Rice_Blast.fertilizer: Urea: 40kg/acre (3 split doses), DAP: 60kg/acre, MOP: 20kg/acre. Apply Zinc Sulphate 10kg/acre.
Rice_Blast.pesticide: Tricyclazole 75% WP (0.6g/L) OR Carbendazim 50% WP (1g/L) OR Isoprothiolane 13% SL (2ml/L). Spray at tillering and panicl initiation stages.

Rice_Bacterial_Blight.name: Bacterial Leaf Blight
Rice_Bacterial_Blight.treatment: Use disease-free seeds. Maintain field sanitation. Avoid wounds during transplanting. Apply copper-based sprays.
Rice_Bacterial_Blight.fertilizer: Reduce nitrogen by 25%. Apply Potassium 30kg/acre to boost immunity.
Rice_Bacterial_Blight.pesticide: Copper Oxychloride 50% WP (2.5g/L) OR Streptocycline 17% SP (1g/L) + Copper Oxychloride. Spray at first disease appearance.

Rice_Tungro.name: Tungro Virus
Rice_Tungro.treatment: No cure once infected. Uproot and destroy infected plants. Control green leafhopper vectors with insecticides.
Rice_Tungro.fertilizer: Maintain healthy soil with organic matter. Avoid excessive nitrogen.
Rice_Tungro.pesticide: Imidacloprid 17.8% SL (0.3ml/L) OR Thiamethoxam 25% WG (0.2g/L) to control leafhoppers. Spray every 10 days.

Healthy.name: Healthy Rice
Healthy.treatment: Maintain regular scouting. Keep field weed-free. Ensure proper water management.
Healthy.fertilizer: Continue balanced NPK based on soil test. Apply organic manures.

Wheat_Rust.name: Stem Rust / Leaf Rust
Wheat_Rust.treatment: Early sowing with rust-resistant varieties (HD 2189, PBW 343). Remove volunteer wheat. Ensure proper spacing for air circulation.
Wheat_Rust.fertilizer: Urea: 55kg/acre (split: 1/3 at sowing, 2/3 at tillering), DAP: 50kg/acre, MOP: 20kg/acre.
Wheat_Rust.pesticide: Propiconazole 25% EC (1ml/L) OR Tebuconazole 40% FS (seed treatment) OR Triademinol 25% EC. Spray at ear emergence.

Wheat_Leaf_Spot.name: Brown Rust / Yellow Rust
Wheat_Leaf_Spot.treatment: Use disease-free seeds. Rotate crops with non-cereals. Apply gypsum to improve soil structure.
Wheat_Leaf_Spot.fertilizer: Reduce nitrogen by 20%. Increase potassium by 10kg/acre.
Wheat_Leaf_Spot.pesticide: Bitertanol 25% WP (1g/L) OR Hexaconazole 5% SC (1ml/L). Two sprays at 10-day interval.

Healthy.name: Healthy Wheat
Healthy.treatment: Maintain field hygiene. Monitor for aphids and rust. Timely irrigation and weeding.

Cotton_Bollworm.name: Bollworm (Helicoverpa)
Cotton_Bollworm.treatment: Early planting (April-May). Install pheromone traps. Maintain field sanitation. Use bio-control agents like Trichogramma.
Cotton_Bollworm.pesticide: Chlorpyrifos 20% EC (2ml/L) OR Profenofos 50% EC (1.5ml/L) OR Spinosad 48% SC (0.5ml/L). Spray on egg laying stage.

Cotton_Leaf_Curl.name: Leaf Curl Virus (CLCuV)
Cotton_Leaf_Curl.treatment: Uproot and bury infected plants completely. Control whitefly vectors. Use resistant hybrids like RCH 2, NCS 2457.
Cotton_Leaf_Curl.fertilizer: Avoid excessive nitrogen. Apply more potash (50kg/acre).
Cotton_Leaf_Curl.pesticide: Imidacloprid 17.8% SL (0.3ml/L) OR Acetamiprid 20% SP (0.2g/L) for whitefly control. Spray every 7-10 days.

Cotton_Root_Rot.name: Root Rot / Wilt
Cotton_Root_Rot.treatment: Solarize soil before sowing. Use well-drained soils. Apply Trichoderma viride (bio-agent).
Cotton_Root_Rot.pesticide: Carbendazim 50% WP (2g/L) as soil drench. Apply Pseudomonas fluorescence.

Healthy.name: Healthy Cotton
Healthy.treatment: Regular scouting. Maintain proper plant spacing. Timely harrowing and weeding.

Maize_Leaf.name: Leaf Blight / Belted Leaf
Maize_Leaf.treatment: Rotate with legumes. Remove infected debris. Use hybrid seeds with disease resistance.
Maize_Leaf.fertilizer: Urea: 80kg/acre, DAP: 100kg/acre, MOP: 40kg/acre. Apply Zinc Sulphate 5kg/acre.
Maize_Leaf.pesticide: Mancozeb 75% WP (2g/L) OR Metalaxyl 8% + Mancozeb 64% WP (2g/L). Spray at 4-6 leaf stage.

Maize_Stem_Borer.name: Stem Borer
Maize_Stem_Borer.treatment: Summer ploughing. Apply FYM/compost. Set up light traps. Release Trichogramma.
Maize_Stem_Borer.fertilizer: Apply NPK 19:19:19 at 4-6 leaf stage as top dressing.
Maize_Stem_Borer.pesticide: Carbofuran 3% CG (20kg/acre) as soil application OR Chlorpyrifos 20% EC (2ml/L) as stem application.

Healthy.name: Healthy Maize
Healthy.treatment: Maintain recommended plant population (18,000-22,000/acre). Timely weed control.
Healthy.fertilizer: Urea: 80kg/acre, DAP: 100kg/acre at sowing. Top dress urea at 30 DAS.

Potato_Early_Blight.name: Early Blight
Potato_Early_Blight.treatment: Use certified seeds. Ensure good drainage. Rotate with non-solanaceous crops.
Potato_Early_Blight.fertilizer: Urea: 50kg/acre, DAP: 125kg/acre, MOP: 60kg/acre. Apply calcium to prevent hollow heart.
Potato_Early_Blight.pesticide: Mancozeb 75% WP (2.5g/L) OR Chlorothalonil 75% WP (2g/L). Spray every 7-10 days.

Potato_Late_Blight.name: Late Blight (Ireland's Famine)
Potato_Late_Blight.treatment: Destroy volunteer potatoes. Use resistant varieties (Kufri Jyoti, Kufri Bahar). Plant in well-drained ridges.
Potato_Late_Blight.fertilizer: Avoid excessive nitrogen. Apply potash 80kg/acre to increase resistance.
Potato_Late_Blight.pesticide: Metalaxyl 8% + Mancozeb 64% WP (2g/L) OR Cymoxanil 20% SC (1ml/L). Spray protectively before disease onset.

Healthy.name: Healthy Potato
Healthy.treatment: Hill up soil regularly. Mulch to conserve moisture. Monitor for aphids and beetles.
Healthy.fertilizer: NPK 20:40:40 at planting. Top-dress with urea at 30 and 60 DAP.

Tomato_Yellow_Leaf_Curl.name: Yellow Leaf Curl Virus (TYLCV)
Tomato_Yellow_Leaf_Curl.treatment: Grow resistant varieties (Arka Abha, Arka Ananya). Use reflective mulch. Uproot infected plants. Control whitefly vectors.
Tomato_Yellow_Leaf_Curl.fertilizer: Reduce nitrogen by 30%. Increase potash to 50kg/acre. Apply boron spray (0.2%).
Tomato_Yellow_Leaf_Curl.pesticide: Imidacloprid 17.8% SL (0.3ml/L) OR Thiamethoxam 25% WG. Spray every 5-7 days to control whitefly.

Tomato_Early_Blight.name: Early Blight (Target Spot)
Tomato_Early_Blight.treatment: Mulch with black plastic. Remove lower leaves. Ensure good air circulation.
Tomato_Early_Blight.fertilizer: Apply calcium nitrate to prevent blossom end rot. Avoid water stress.
Tomato_Early_Blight.pesticide: Mancozeb 75% WP (2.5g/L) OR Chlorothalonil 75% WP (2g/L). Rotate with systemic fungicides.

Tomato_Late_Blight.name: Late Blight
Tomato_Late_Blight.treatment: Plant in well-drained soil. Stake plants for air circulation. Remove infected leaves immediately.
Tomato_Late_Blight.fertilizer: Balanced NPK without excess nitrogen. Apply silicon if available.
Tomato_Late_Blight.pesticide: Metalaxyl 8% + Mancozeb 64% WP (2g/L) OR Systemic acid (0.5ml/L). Spray preventively in humid weather.

Tomato_Fruit_Borer.name: Fruit Borer (Helicoverpa)
Tomato_Fruit_Borer.treatment: Install pheromone traps. Handpick infected fruits. Maintain Field sanitation.
Tomato_Fruit_Borer.pesticide: Emamectin Benzoate 5% SG (0.5ml/L) OR Indoxacarb 15.8% EC (1ml/L). Spray at fruit setting stage.

Healthy.name: Healthy Tomato
Healthy.treatment: Regular monitoring. Support plants with stakes. Mulch to suppress weeds.
Healthy.fertilizer: NPK 12:24:12 at planting. Follow with NPK 19:19:19 at flowering.

Groundnut_Leaf_Spot.name: Leaf Spot (Cercospora)
Groundnut_Leaf_Spot.treatment: Crop rotation with cereals. Use disease-free seeds. Burn crop residues after harvest.
Groundnut_Leaf_Spot.fertilizer: Urea: 25kg/acre, SSP: 100kg/acre, MOP: 40kg/acre. Apply Gypsum 200kg/acre at flowering.
Groundnut_Leaf_Spot.pesticide: Carbendazim 12% + Mancozeb 63% WP (2g/L) OR Copper Oxychloride 50% WP (2.5g/L).

Groundnut_Rust.name: Groundnut Rust
Groundnut_Rust.treatment: Early sowing (June). Use rust-resistant varieties (TMV 2, TMV 37).
Groundnut_Rust.fertilizer: Apply more potash (50kg/acre). Reduce nitrogen to 20kg/acre.
Groundnut_Rust.pesticide: Propiconazole 25% EC (1ml/L) OR Hexaconazole 5% SC. Two sprays at 15-day interval.

Healthy.name: Healthy Groundnut
Healthy.treatment: Maintain proper plant spacing. Irrigate at pod development stage. Use gypsum for pod filling.

Sugarcane_Red_Rot.name: Red Rot
Sugarcane_Red_Rot.treatment: Use disease-free setts. Hot water treatment (52°C for 30 min). Drain excess water. Apply lime to soil.
Sugarcane_Red_Rot.fertilizer: Urea: 150kg/acre, DAP: 100kg/acre, MOP: 60kg/acre. Apply Neem cake or castor cake.
Sugarcane_Red_Rot.pesticide: Carbendazim 50% WP (0.5%) as setts dip. Apply Pseudomonas fluorescence @ 10g/kg soil.

Sugarcane_Grasshopper.name: Grasshopper / Locust
Sugarcane_Grasshopper.treatment: Deep summer ploughing. Remove weeds from bunds. Use bait sprays.
Sugarcane_Grasshopper.fertilizer: Maintain healthy growth with adequate nitrogen.
Sugarcane_Grasshopper.pesticide: Chlorpyrifos 20% EC (2ml/L) OR Malathion 50% EC (2ml/L). Spray in early morning.

Healthy.name: Healthy Sugarcane
Healthy.treatment: Setts treatment before planting. Maintain proper plant population. Intercrop with legumes.
Healthy.fertilizer: Urea: 150kg/acre in split doses, DAP: 100kg/acre, MOP: 60kg/acre.

Alluvial.health: Very fertile, high in potash and phosphorus. Good water holding capacity. Found in Ganga-Brahmaputra plains.
Alluvial.nutrients: Requires moderate nitrogen. Apply Urea 50kg/acre, DAP 50kg/acre. Add organic manure yearly.

Black.health: Clayey, high moisture retention. Rich in calcium carbonate but poor in organic matter. Found in Deccan plateau (Maharashtra, Gujarat).
Black.nutrients: Add Nitrogen heavily. Apply Urea 60kg/acre, SSP 40kg/acre. Use green manuring (Dhaincha).

Red.health: Low fertility, acidic, porous. Deficient in nitrogen, phosphorus, and organic matter. Found in Tamil Nadu, Andhra Pradesh, Karnataka.
Red.nutrients: Apply large quantities of organic compost. Use green manures (Pillipesara, Daincha). Add lime to reduce acidity. Apply NPK 20:20:20.

Laterite.health: Rich in iron and aluminum oxides. Acidic, low fertility. Found in Western Ghats, parts of Odisha, Chhattisgarh.
Laterite.nutrients: Apply lime 1ton/acre. Use acid-tolerant crops. Add organic manure extensively.

Desert.health: Sandy, low water holding capacity, high pH. Found in Rajasthan, Gujarat, Haryana.
Desert.nutrients: Add organic matter to improve soil structure. Apply fertilizers in small splits. Use gypsum to reduce sodicity.

Mountain.health: Shallow, acidic, high organic matter in top layer. Found in Himachal Pradesh, Uttarakhand, NE states.
Mountain.nutrients: Apply phosphate fertilizers (SSP, DAP) as they get fixed in acidic soil. Use lime to raise pH if needed.

Marshy.health: Waterlogged, anaerobic, high salinity. Found in Sundarbans, coastal wetlands.
Marshy.nutrients: Use water-tolerant varieties. Apply nitrogen as top-dressing after drainage. Add organic matter.
